evidence.title: LSU AgCenter Pub. 3153 "Blast of Rice" (Groth & Hollier, 6/10) (LSU-Blast)
evidence.excerpt: Leaf spots start as small white, gray or bluish specks. Under humid conditions they enlarge quickly into elliptical or diamond-shaped spots or linear lesions pointed at both ends, with gray to white centers and narrow brown borders. In severe cases leaves and whole plants die

evidence.title: Sri Lanka Department of Agriculture, Rice Research & Development Institute, Rice blast page (DOA-SriLanka)
evidence.excerpt: Spindle-shaped leaf spots with brown or reddish-brown to yellowish-brown borders, ashy centers and pointed ends. Fully developed lesions are usually 1.0–1.5 cm long and 0.3–0.5 cm wide. Symptoms vary with growth stage, cultivar susceptibility and environment

evidence.title: LSU AgCenter Pub. 3123 "Sheath Blight of Rice" (2 pages) (LSU-SB)
evidence.excerpt: Large oval spots form on the leaf sheath. Lesions about 0.5–1 cm wide and 1–3 cm long form slightly above the water line on infected stems. Lesion centers are grayish-white or light green, with brown to reddish-brown borders

evidence.title: IRRI RKB "Sheath blight" (IRRI-Sheath blight)
evidence.excerpt: Resembles stem rot and stem-borer damage. Confirm by irregular sheath lesions (water-soaked to gray-green early, grayish-white with brown border later) and the presence of sclerotia

evidence.title: IRRI RKB "Brown spot" (IRRI-Brown spot)
evidence.excerpt: On some cultivars it can be mistaken for blast lesions. Confirm by round brown spots with gray centers surrounded by reddish-brown borders

evidence.title: NCPMS paddy rice Brown spot (NCPMS-Brown spot)
evidence.excerpt: Grains develop dark-brown spots that later become grayish-white collapsed areas. Often the whole grain surface browns. Unlike blast, it does not attack quickly from the panicle tip and does not cause whiteheads

supporting_evidence.source_name: LSU AgCenter Pub. 3153 "Blast of Rice" (Groth & Hollier, 6/10) (LSU-Blast)
supporting_evidence.growth_stage: Seedling to late tillering (leaf blast phase)
supporting_evidence.source_conflicts: ["Leaf lesion border color differs between sources: NCPMS gives 'red' for the chronic type, IRRI 'red to brown or necrotic', LSU 'narrow brown', and the Sri Lanka Department of Agriculture 'brown, reddish-brown or yellowish-brown'. For early spots, IRRI describes white to gray-green with dark green borders, while LSU describes white, gray or bluish.", "Lesion size (1.0–1.5 × 0.3–0.5 cm) appears only in the Sri Lanka Department of Agriculture page, with no original source cited. NCPMS, IRRI and LSU give no size, so this figure must not be used as if it were a Korean standard.", "Node lesion color is dark brown in NCPMS, black to gray-brown (banded) in IRRI, and black rot in Sri Lanka; neck color is light brown in NCPMS and gray-brown in IRRI.", "Only NCPMS explicitly mentions gray mold (signs) on lesions.", "Conidial size 14–37 × 5–12 µm appears only in NCPMS and could not be cross-checked. Color also differs: NCPMS says 'colorless' while the Klaubauf 2014 genus description says 'colorless to pale brown', and the Klaubauf 2014 *P. oryzae* entry gives no size.", "The NCPMS leaf blast and panicle blast pages have character-for-character identical pathogen, environment and symptom text, so they cannot count as two independent sources.", "Scientific names differ (NCPMS *Magnaporthe grisea*, LSU *Pyricularia grisea*). Klaubauf 2014 separates *P. oryzae* and *P. grisea* as distinct species.", "Timing is given by the Korean calendar in NCPMS (paddy field from late June; around heading) and by US growth stages in LSU (leaf blast from seedling to late tillering; neck blast at heading)."]

environment_assessments.thresholds_text: Wetness requirements: 17 h at 15 C to 10 h at 22–25 C; previous five-day mean 20–25 C (Hiroshima BLASTAM). 20–25 C, at least three rainy days, RH at least 90%, and limited sunshine (RDA, Korea). Panicle infection: 0–300 degree-days after heading (Kobayashi et al., international). Sources: [Hiroshima BLASTAM Table 1](https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/uploaded/attachment/535771.pdf); [RDA 2023-06-15](https://rda.go.kr/board/board.do?mode=view&prgId=day_farmprmninfoEntry&dataNo=100000788240); [Kobayashi et al. 2010](https://www.jppa.or.jp/archive/pdf/64_02_01.pdf)
